CustomField.label: Confirmation
CustomField.description: A question to ask before an autolaunched flow runs, such as "Send the renewal quote?". If blank, a run on selected rows still asks and names them; one on a single row runs at once unless the row has unsaved changes.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Optional question shown before an autolaunched flow runs, such as "Send the renewal quote?". Leave blank to use the standard confirmation.
